title: applied-ml-weekly-notes-2026-03-31
content:
Applied ML weekly notes (week of 2026-03-31)

Summary:
- Focus this week: quantization experiments (PTQ and QAT), expanded eval suite for onboarding Llama-3 variants, and finalizing model onboarding checklist for Dedicated/Private.
- Key outcomes: promising 4-bit PTQ results on smaller 13B and 30B variants; initial regressions on long-context QA identified and triaged.

Standup highlights (03/31):
- Sofia: ran full eval sweep for 13B-quantized candidate (PTQ-4g) across our internal narrow-QA and summarization sets. Collected latency, memory, and accuracy deltas.
- Ethan: benchmarked kernel throughput with new fused attention kernel on RTX-H100; merged microbench harness into runtime branch (PR #678). Still seeing cache-eviction edge case for long (>4096) contexts.
- Lena: prepared onboarding checklist draft for Llama-3-70B; started packaging model-card metadata and cost-profile.
- Marcus: continuing eval automation: added adversarial QA test to regression set and instrumented failure-case capture into S3 for triage.

Quantization experiments (PTQ and QAT):
- Models tested: 13B open variant (v1.2), 30B open variant (v2.0), and internal Llama-3-70B (sanitized dev copy).
- Methods: per-channel symmetric 4-bit PTQ with outlier-clipping (method: clamp-0.999), and per-tensor 8-bit baseline. Also one LoRA QAT run on 13B (2-3 epochs).
- Metrics (narrow-QA / summarization / latency @ batch=1):
  - 13B FP16 baseline: Exact-match QA 68.3%, Rouge-L 42.7, latency=220ms, mem=16.4GB
  - 13B 8-bit PTQ: EM 67.9% (-0.4), Rouge-L 42.4 (-0.3), latency=195ms, mem=11.5GB
  - 13B 4-bit PTQ (PTQ-4g): EM 67.1% (-1.2), Rouge-L 41.8 (-0.9), latency=150ms, mem=7.2GB
  - 13B 4-bit + LoRA QAT (1 epoch small data): EM 67.6% (-0.7), Rouge-L 42.2 (-0.5), latency=155ms, mem=7.3GB
- Observations: 4-bit PTQ gives ~50-60% memory savings and ~1.3-1.5x throughput lift vs FP16 for batch=1. Small but measurable drop on narrow-QA, larger drop on some adversarial QA samples. LoRA QAT recovers ~0.5% EM for 13B with minimal extra cost in inference.
- Failure modes: long-context retrieval QA shows drift in answer fidelity for PTQ-4g; root cause appears related to KV-cache numeric noise when sequence length > 4096. Ethan is reproducing with synthetic sequences.

Evals and regression tracking:
- Expanded eval suite this week: added 2k adversarial QA examples from CS customer tickets and 1k long-context QA cases. These are included in the weekly regression dashboard.
- Regression thresholds: we set hard thresholds for narrow-QA EM delta <= -1.0% and Rouge-L delta <= -1.5 for any candidate to be considered for production. PTQ-4g on 30B exceeded thresholds on adversarial set; will not promote without QAT.
- Instrumentation: failure traces uploaded to s3://redwood-applied-ml/telemetry/2026-03-31/ for triage. Marcus added automated diff generation and summary emails to #applied-ml-results.

Model onboarding (Llama-3 family):
- Checklist status: model-card draft, license check, cost-profile, memory/latency benchmarks, per-route safety filters, and eval-suite verdicts.
- Current blockers: incomplete safety scan (security team) and missing optimized kernels for large attention patterns (>8192) on some private GPU SKUs.
- Next steps: finalize packaging (Lena), get security sign-off (owner: Priya from security), and run Dedicated capacity profiling (request queued with infra: AM-482).

Action items & owners:
- Ethan: reproduce KV-cache numeric noise with synthetic long sequences and open issue with kernel traces (due 2026-04-03). Linked to PR #678 for kernel changes.
- Sofia: run LoRA QAT sweep on 30B (2 hyperparameter configs) and report quality vs cost tradeoffs (due 2026-04-07).
- Lena: finish onboarding checklist and create model-card + metadata bundle for Llama-3-70B (due 2026-04-05).
- Marcus: add expanded adversarial suite to nightly eval job and verify alerts for regressions > threshold (due 2026-04-02).
- Cross-team: schedule sync with Serving Runtime and SRE to discuss long-context KV-cache behavior and fallback policies (target meeting 2026-04-06).

Blockers / risks:
- Kernel-level numeric instability on long contexts prevents safe promotion of PTQ-4g for our default long-context route. This is high priority (affects Dedicated/Private customers using retrieval-heavy apps).
- Security scan for Llama-3-70B still pending; cannot onboard to Private without clearance.
- Eval set growth: we need to budget more GPU time for nightly large-sweep regressions if we continue to expand adversarial tests. Cost vs coverage tradeoff to discuss with product.

Notes / links from this week:
- Slack thread: #applied-ml-thread-quant-results contains plots and raw eval tables (see linked_artifacts).
- Runtime PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/678 — fused attention microbench and initial fixes (Ethan).
- Jira ticket for Dedicated profiling request: AM-482.

Open questions for next week:
- Is LoRA QAT at small scale a sustainable recovery path for 4-bit quant on larger models, or do we need full QAT/FT? Cost estimate needed.
- Should we set an explicit latency SLO uplift allowance for quantized variants to prioritize throughput gains for batch workloads? (Discuss with Product).

Quick TODOs (notes-to-self):
- Add a short section in onboarding checklist about quantization fallback policies (per-route): what to route to FP16 vs quantized variant based on route SLA.
- Export full eval CSV and attach to Confluence page for AM-482.

End of week note.
